Name: Recurring Reminders
Author: Dem1se7990
Description:
[center][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][b]This mod has been unified with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6215]CustomReminders[/url][/b] v2.0+
[color=#ff0000]This mod will not be supported or updated any further.[/color]
[size=4]However you can still download and use this mod if you choose to, as long as it still works.[/size]
﻿[/size][/font][/center][size=5]Example use cases:
[/size]
Using this mod you can set reminders in game, for example,

[list]
[*]Check the cave for mushrooms or fruits
[*]Check the greenhouse
[*]Check the cellar
[*]or any other thing that happens in regular interval
[/list]for other stuff, check out Custom Reminders[size=5]

Features:[/size][b][u][size=5]
[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Create new reminders that will notify at specified Interval (starting from the day reminder was created) and Time.
[*]All the reminders are[i] [b]save specific[/b][/i]. Reminders set in one save won't be visible and won't notify there either.
[*][b][i]View[/i] [/b]currently set reminders with their Date & Time.
[*][i][b]Delete[/b][/i] currently set reminders from the above UI.
[*]Reminder notifications have Configurable[b] [i]notification sound.[/i][/b]
[*]Reminder messages can be set in [i][b]any language[/b][/i] supported by Stardew valley.
[/list]
The mod is [url=https://github.com/dem1se/SDVMods]open source[/url]﻿﻿  and in active development.
[b]Use the mod by pressing F3 ([/b]Configurable through config.json file[b])

[/b][size=5]Install:
[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI.[/url]
[*]Unzip the download into the ﻿[code]Stardew Valley﻿/mods[/code]
[*]Bring up the menu by pressing F2 (Configurable)
[/list][b]
[/b][size=5]Compatibility:[/size][b][b][u][size=5]
[/size][/u][/b]
[/b][list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.4.x [1.1.0]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5+ [1.2.0]
[*]Fully compatible with Windows/Mac/Linux
[*]Supports Singleplayer and Multiplayer [1.4.2+] -- All player in co-op can set own, separate reminders.
[*]Reminder messages support any language supported by Stardew valley.
[*]Supports MobilePhone mod. ﻿
[*]Supports Platonymous's Mod Updater.
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
- Increased interval limit from 28 to 999. Yearly reminders (e.g. birthdays) are possible now!
